unitTitle: Some - Any/Much - Many/A Few - A Little/Phrases of Quantity - Giving Advice - Conditionals Type 0 - Time Words

pairsWith.noteUz: Miqdor so'zlari mashqlari: some/any/much/many/a few/a little.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 6-UNIT MAShQLAR (31-bet, PDF 30). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '6'.

CHAP USTUN:
2) 'Underline the correct word.' SURAT: salat sabzavotlari (karam, pomidor, sabzi, qalampir, non). A: Have we got everything we need for the salad? B: Let me see. Well, there are 1) some/any tomatoes, but there isn't 2) any/many cheese. A: How 3) many/much feta cheese do you need? B: Just 4) a little/a few. I need 5) some/a little olives, too. A: How 6) much/many olives do you need? B: Not 7) any/many. Just 8) a few/a little. A: Are there 9) any/much green peppers left? B: No. We haven't got 10) a little/any onions, either. A: Is there anything else you need? B: I almost forgot! We need 11) some/much bread and 12) a few/a little olive oil. A: Right! What's a salad without bread and olive oil?
3) 'Join the sentences in column A with one from column B using "A few" or "A little", as in the example.' Namuna: How many sandwiches shall I make for the picnic? A few. Can I have cheese and tomato? Column A: a Do you want any sugar in your coffee? b Would you like mustard in your hamburger? c How much money have you got? d Can you stay a bit longer? e Did you find any dresses you liked? f Have we got any milk left? g Are there any apples in the fridge? h How many sandwiches shall I make for the picnic? Column C (B): - Can I have cheese and tomato? - Then I'll have to leave and catch the bus. - But none of them were my size. - Can I have ketchup as well? - I'll go to the shop and buy some more. - I'm trying to lose weight. - So let's not go anywhere very expensive. - But not enough to make a pie. O'rtada 'A few / A little' doira.

O'NG USTUN:
4) 'Tom is asking his friend about what food he needs to buy. Use much or many to write his answers, as in the examples.' SURAT: erkak do'konda telefonda gaplashyapti, qalampirlar. 1 We've got some fish. How much have we got? 2 We haven't got many potatoes. How many do we need? 3 We need some oranges. 4 We've got some cheese. 5 We need some mushrooms. 6 We haven't got any sausages. 7 We've got some ketchup. 8 We need some milk. 9 We haven't got much butter. 10 We haven't got any eggs.
5) 'Fill in the gaps below with much or many.' 1 A: How ...... rice would you like? B: Half a kilo, please. 2 A: Were there ...... people at the party? B: Oh, about twenty. 3 A: There isn't ...... cat food left. B: Okay, I'll pick some up on my way home. 4 A: Have you got any candles? B: Not ...... I'm afraid. Just two. 5 A: How ...... does this dress cost, please? B: £12.00. 6 A: Did you have ...... toys when you were young? B: Oh, yes! Too ......, actually. 7 A: How ...... eggs do you need for the cake? B: Not ...... . Just three.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '31'.

exercises.explanationUz:
SALAT UChUN XARID - MIQDOR SO'ZLARI.

  1 SOME tomatoes (tasdiq)
  2 ANY cheese (inkor, sanalmaydigan)
  3 How MUCH feta cheese
    (sanalmaydigan)
  4 A LITTLE (cheese - sanalmaydigan)
  5 SOME olives (tasdiq)
  6 How MANY olives (ko'plik)
  7 Not MANY (olives)
  8 A FEW (olives - ko'plik)
  9 ANY green peppers (savol)
  10 ANY onions (inkor)
  11 SOME bread (tasdiq)
  12 A LITTLE olive oil
     (sanalmaydigan)


⚠ 'FETA CHEESE':

  = feta pishlog'i (yunon).


⚠ 'EITHER' (inkor oxirida):

  = ham (inkor gapda 'too' o'rniga).

exercises.explanationUz:
A FEW (ko'plik) / A LITTLE
  (sanalmaydigan) + MOS JAVOB.

  a sugar → A LITTLE. I'm trying
    to lose weight.
  b mustard → A LITTLE. Can I have
    ketchup as well?
  c money → A LITTLE. So let's not
    go anywhere very expensive.
  d stay a bit longer → A LITTLE.
    Then I'll have to leave and
    catch the bus.
  e dresses → A FEW. But none of
    them were my size.
  f milk → A LITTLE. I'll go to
    the shop and buy some more.
  g apples → A FEW. But not enough
    to make a pie.
  h sandwiches → A FEW. Can I have
    cheese and tomato? (NAMUNA)


⚠ 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':

  = ozmoq.


⚠ 'MUSTARD':

  = xantal (gorchitsa).

exercises.instructionEn: Tom is asking his friend about what food he needs to buy. Use much or many to write his answers, as in the examples. 1 We've got some fish. → How much have we got? 2 We haven't got many potatoes. → How many do we need? 3 We need some oranges. 4 We've got some cheese. 5 We need some mushrooms. 6 We haven't got any sausages. 7 We've got some ketchup. 8 We need some milk. 9 We haven't got much butter. 10 We haven't got any eggs.
exercises.instructionUz: Tom do'stidan qanday oziq-ovqat sotib olish kerakligini so'rayapti. Much yoki many bilan uning javoblarini yozing, namunadagidek. 1 Bizda baliq bor. → Qancha bor? 2 Kartoshka ko'p emas. → Qancha kerak? 3 Apelsin kerak. 4 Pishloq bor. 5 Qo'ziqorin kerak. 6 Sosiska yo'q. 7 Ketchup bor. 8 Sut kerak. 9 Sariyog' ko'p emas. 10 Tuxum yo'q.
exercises.explanationUz:
HOW MUCH / HOW MANY SAVOLLARI.

  'We've got' → How much/many HAVE
    WE GOT?
  'We need' / 'haven't got' → How
    much/many DO WE NEED?

  SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH: fish,
    cheese, ketchup, milk, butter
  KO'PLIK → HOW MANY: potatoes,
    oranges, mushrooms, sausages,
    eggs
exercises.exampleEn: 1 How much have we got? 2 How many do we need?

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps below with much or many.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi bo'shliqlarni much yoki many bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUCH / MANY.

  1 How MUCH rice (sanalmaydigan)
  2 MANY people (ko'plik)
  3 MUCH cat food (sanalmaydigan)
  4 Not MANY (candles)
  5 How MUCH does it cost (narx)
  6 MANY toys / Too MANY (ko'plik)
  7 How MANY eggs / Not MANY


⚠ 'HOW MUCH DOES IT COST?':

  = narxi qancha? (har doim much)


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = olib kelmoq (yo'l-yo'lakay).

patterns.formula: How much + SANALMAYDIGAN + do you need? — A little. / How many + KO'PLIK ...? — A few.
patterns.exampleEn: How much feta cheese do you need? — Just a little. How many olives do you need? — Just a few.
patterns.exampleUz: Qancha feta pishlog'i kerak? — Bir oz. Nechta zaytun kerak? — Bir nechta.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ much/a little - sanalmaydigan; many/a few - ko'plik.

patterns.formula: There isn't much ... / We haven't got any ... / Not many.
patterns.exampleEn: There isn't much cat food left. We haven't got any onions, either. Not many, I'm afraid. Just two.
patterns.exampleUz: Mushuk ovqati ko'p qolmagan. Piyoz ham yo'q. Afsuski ko'p emas. Faqat ikkita.

patterns.exampleEn: How much does this dress cost? — £12.00.
